The first person talks about himself alone ("I say", or with other people in the plural, "we say").
Calque of Latin prīma persōna, itself a calque of Ancient Greek πρῶτον πρόσωπον (prôton prósōpon). Equivalent to forma (“first”) + hād (“grammatical person”)

The second person is whoever the first person talks to ("you say", or in the plural "you guys say").
